title: Discrepancy between self-report and neurophysiological markers of socio-affective responses in lonely individuals
description: EEG and behavioral data from 148 neurologically healthy adults performing an emotion processing and regulation task with static social and non-social images. Participants passively watched neutral or negative images or reappraised negative ones, then rated arousal and valence. The dataset supports examination of discrepancies between self-reported and neurophysiological markers of socio-affective responses in lonely individuals.
methods_description: 64-channel QuickCap EEG recorded with a Neuroscan SynampsRT amplifier at 1000 Hz, with additional EOG, EKG and GSR/EDA sensors. Each of 240 trials in a 2 (content: social, non-social) × 3 (watch-neutral, watch-negative, reappraise-negative) design presented a static image for 5 s, followed by arousal and valence ratings on 9-point scales. Preprocessing used EEGLAB and ERPLAB: 0.1-30 Hz filtering, downsampling to 250 Hz, mastoid re-referencing, clean_rawdata, ICA with ADJUST/SASICA, epoching, baseline correction and artifact rejection.
